Together they follow the trail through the forest, across frozen streams and up to a little hill. What will they find at the end of the footprints? Their journey has just begun!
current_editorial.job: Winter Ranger Bao Explores the snowy world Looks for animal tracks Keeps the team on track Believes in big adventures Nature always has amazing stories to tell!
current_editorial.challenge: Make someone smile on a cold day. It can be a kind word, a small help or a nice drawing! Kindness makes the world warmer!
current_editorial.footer-left: Did you know? Different animals leave different footprints in the snow. Can you match them to the right animal?

current_editorial.footer-right: Kindness helps friends, families and communities feel happier and more connected

current_editorial.story: In March, spring arrives in the village and the Giggle Dumplings want to plant seeds in the garden. Gardener Bao notices a little trail of seeds on the ground. Curious, he follows the trail through the village and fields. At the old tree, he makes a surprising discovery - the trail led to a third shining star! But then Bao realizes the reason for the missing seeds: his own seed bag has a small hole! Even small mistakes can lead to wonderful adventures!
current_editorial.job: Gardener Bao Plants seeds and flowers Cares for the village garden Helps nature and animal friends Shows that patience leads to beautiful results A greener world starts with small steps!
current_editorial.challenge: Plant something (or take care of a plant). It can be a flower, a herb or even just a small seed in a pot! Seeds Kindness helps things grow!
current_editorial.footer-left: Did you know? Seeds can travel in many ways - by wind, by water, by animals or even on people's shoes! In nature, everything is connected.
current_editorial.footer-right: Healthy plants make clean air, provide food for animals and create colorful places for everyone to enjoy.
